title: Smiling Toddler with Plaid Stuffed Bunny, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful mid-century domestic snapshot taken in June 1956 featuring a cheerful toddler learning to stand. The toddler, dressed in light-colored overalls and tiny walking shoes, leans gently against a bed or divan covered in a textured dotted bedspread. Standing beside the child is a large stuffed rabbit toy wearing a plaid suit. The photo features scalloped deckle edges and a timestamped border ('JUN · 56'), capturing the innocence of American postwar childhood.
